leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the useState hook to initialize and manage a state array for tracking history of values.
Use the useState hook to create and control a state variable representing the current position in the history.
Implement a handler function to update the main state while preserving the previous state in the history array.
Execute conditional logic to prevent adding duplicate consecutive states to the history array.
Construct an undo handler that decrements the history position and retrieves the previous state.
Construct a redo handler that increments the history position and retrieves the next state.
Define and invoke a function to reset the history when the main state is updated via the primary handler.
Utilize conditional statements to disable undo and redo buttons when at the beginning or end of the history.
Control component rendering by returning the current state from the history based on the position index.
Access the history array length to determine if undo or redo operations are possible.
Modify event handlers to call the appropriate undo, redo, or state update functions.
Return JSX structure with interactive buttons wired to the undo, redo, and state update handlers.
